A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''captain''' of a faction of [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3641 BBY]], he considered joining with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]], but was killed by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].
